pf2e-kemenor-toolkit.conflict: PF2e Kemenor Toolkit: pf2e-eidolon-helper is also enabled. Both modules redirect eidolon hit point updates and will fight over them. Disable one.

sharedHP.name: Shared hit point pool
sharedHP.hint: The eidolon has no hit points of its own: it reads and writes its summoner's pool. Dying, wounded and drained are applied to the summoner.

sharedHeroPoints.name: Shared hero points
sharedHeroPoints.hint: The eidolon reads and writes its summoner's hero points.

sharedInvestiture.name: Shared investiture
sharedInvestiture.hint: Apply the summoner's invested-item benefits to the eidolon: handwraps or shared-weapon runes on its Strikes, armor potency or bands of force to AC, resilient to saves, and item bonuses to Perception and skills.

autoLink.name: Link summoners automatically
autoLink.hint: On world load, link each unlinked summoner to its eidolon when exactly one eidolon shares an owner with them. No macro, no targeting.

autoDismiss.name: Dismiss at 0 hit points
autoDismiss.hint: Remove the eidolon's tokens when the shared pool reaches 0.

autoLink.ambiguous: {summoner} has {count} possible eidolons. Link one manually with game.kemenorToolkit.link(summoner, eidolon).

manifest.noEidolon: That summoner has no linked eidolon.
manifest.noToken: The summoner has no token on any scene.
manifest.already: The eidolon is already manifested on this scene.
manifest.noPermission: You do not have permission to create or delete tokens on this scene.

shared.title: Share weapon runes with eidolon
shared.hint: Pick the magic weapon your eidolon's Strikes borrow runes from. It is given the invested trait and Invested for you, so it counts against your ten-item investiture limit and the inventory's own Invest toggle turns the sharing on and off. The runes only apply while you are holding it. Invested handwraps of mighty blows always take precedence.
shared.noMagicWeapons: This summoner carries no weapons with runes.
